name: 画像からの検索結果の切替見出し
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH01-0067 画像からの検索結果の切替見出し. Input1 ORIGINAL exact bottomsheet-header crop controls handle, rounded top corners, two-tab alignment and SECOND selected underline. Input2 Japanese native mock supplies exact labels; Input3 approved white style only.
Compact WHITE bottomsheet-header fragment on purewhite#FFFFFF. Rounded upper corners, subtle neutral edge and restrained shadow. Small neutralgray horizontal drag handle centered at top, approximately9% of header width, rounded ends. Beneath exactly TWO centered tabs: "関連する画像" and "場所を探す". Second "場所を探す" is SELECTED with a thin forest-green #1F6444 underline directly below that label, same optical width as text. First has no underline. Both labels MeiryoRegular40014/24, tracking0, darkink; selected label may use same forestgreen. Match original underline position/weight and compact spacing, preserve visible state.
No filled selected pill, broadmint, whole-width underline, thirdtab, giantheading, extraicons or controls. Accentdecision: adapt original black selected underline to forestgreen as the sole state accent; ordinary white surface/neutral handle. Keep Japanese native wording, not Explore/Shop. No flower/photo, camera crop, cards/device or English outside scoped header. Highresolutionfrontalwidefragmentabout4.7:1, modestwhite margins, all labels visible/unclipped. Rastercandidateonly; tab/drag behavior and fontidentity unverified.
reviewNotes: Original full/crop, mock and style inspected. Exact two labels, centered handle and second-tab green underline are present. Selected label became visibly bold compared with the locked Regular role and first tab; make a text-weight-only correction. No owner acceptance.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
